thread:
maya singh: Preflight: DB migration backout checklist for tonight's 22:00 UTC changewindow. Canary at +15m. Please ack and confirm backups, pins, and smoke test owners. Links in thread.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled rollout v1.38.2-mig to prod on 2026-03-21T22:00Z. Canary allocated to pool 'canary-small' (5%).

liam chen: ack. I'll create DB snapshot and lock schema changes. ETA 10m.

liam chen: DB snapshot done: snapshot id snap-prod-4523456789. S3 backup: s3://redwood-backups/4523456789.tar.gz

sasha: I pinned api-service -> v1.38.2 for canary route. Will monitor latency. Disabled async-job 'metrics-aggregator' for 30m.

jordan: Who owns smoke tests? I'll run the suite once canary is live. Also confirming rollback SQL is tested.

maya singh: Runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/db-migration-backout. Key steps: restore snapshot, flip feature flag, unpin traffic. ops-bot will post runbook excerpt.

ops-bot: ops-bot: excerpted runbook snippet:
```
-- rollback steps
PAUSE writes to shard_a; wait for quiesce
RESTORE FROM 'snap-prod-4523456789' TO shard_a
SWITCH feature_flag 'new_index' -> false
UNPIN api-service -> v1.37.9
RE-enable async-job 'metrics-aggregator' after verification
```

liam chen: Confirmed restore dry-run succeeded in staging 03/20. Timing to restore ~6m for primary shard.

sasha: Can we add a fast-fail alert on canary: 5xx rate > 1% for 3m triggers immediate rollback? I'll add that to the dashboard.

maya singh: Yes. Rollback criteria: (1) 5xx spike, (2) DB write errors, (3) >2min KV cache miss storm. If triggered, we switch to backout flow and pause migrator.

jordan: @liam chen @sasha who owns post-rollback verification? Need someone to validate consumer offsets and replay state.

liam chen: I'll do verification and post status to #incidents when complete. ETA 10m after rollback.

sasha: :thumbsup: All set from my side. Smoke tests owner @jordan. Ready to proceed.

maya singh: Thanks. If no objections, we start canary at T+0 (22:00). Keep channel open. :eyes:

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary started for v1.38.2-mig at 4523456810. Monitoring enabled.

sasha: canary metrics: latency +3ms, 5xx 0.1%, DB writes nominal.

jordan: smoke tests running... 12/12 passing so far.

sasha: rolling to 20% in 10m unless we see regressions.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rolled to 20% at 4523456825.

maya singh: Closing preflight. Backout runbook referenced, owners assigned. I'll ping if anything changes.
